description: List what a script can call: the Crevio API (crevioApi), Crevio's own tools (platform), and every integration you can use, each as a namespace under `tools`, plus the account's other connected apps and their status. Then list a namespace's functions with list_integration_tools.
name: list_integrations

label.description: Which connected account, when the app is connected more than once or personally.

namespace.description: The module a script calls it through: tools.<namespace>.<function>.

other_connections.description: Connected apps without a namespace of their own: expired ones need reconnecting in Crevio, social accounts are reached through crevioApi, and the rest serve Crevio itself (Slack for chat, GitHub for sites).
